lcc_original: 以諾生以拿，以拿生米戶雅利，米戶雅利生瑪土撒利，瑪土撒利生拉麥。
notes: LCC uses commas (，) where UNV uses semicolons (；) — LCC punctuation preserved exactly
Hebrew direct object marker את ({<WAH0853>}) has no explicit LCC word in any of the four clauses, so implicit braces are retained throughout
First 生 carries <WTH8735> (Niphal imperfect); subsequent three 生 carry <WTH8804> (Qal perfect) — morphology distinctions preserved as-is from UNV
